items.title: The founder’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know

items.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
items.summary: Meta's total fine has raked up to $942 million in this case

items.title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
items.summary: Additional details about OpenAI's mysterious new AI device make it sound like a pricey smart speaker.

items.title: Vogue just gave another nod of approval to the tech world
items.summary: Vogue World is coming to San Francisco next year — perhaps another indication that tech bros are now part of the fashion zeitgeist.

items.title: Get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until tomorrow
items.summary: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

items.title: Google says hackers are calling financial firm employees to hack and extort victims
items.summary: Groups of hackers are breaking into large U.S. financial firms to steal sensitive data and extort victims, Google’s security researchers report.

items.title: China-linked LightSpy spyware caught targeting victims in 13 countries, including the US
items.summary: Researchers linked the latest malicious activity to a Chinese company, after one of the spyware's operators placed an order with KFC using their real name and office address.

items.title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
items.summary: Hadrian is building automated factories to mass-produce parts for defense vehicles like submarines. It's backed by a long list of well-known investors.

items.title: Ford needs another Taurus, and the $30K Fathom EV pickup isn’t it
items.summary: Ford's CEO has described the new Ford Fathom as a "Model T moment" for the company. But the EV pickup is unlikely to live up to lofty expectations, and maybe it doesn't have to.

items.title: Bumble teases a swipe-free future as it doubles down on IRL meetups
items.summary: Bumble says it’s moving beyond swiping and deeper into real-world social experiences as it courts Gen Z users.

items.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
items.summary: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.

items.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
items.summary: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.

items.title: Hacker pleads guilty to stealing data from more than 165 Snowflake customers
items.summary: Connor Moucka pled guilty to hacking and stealing data from more than 165 Snowflake customers, which net him and his accomplices more than $2.5 million in ransom payments.

items.title: TikTok lays off 250 employees, shutters its Nashville office
items.summary: The social media giant is shuttering an office that housed some members of TikTok’s content-moderation team.

items.title: Google Wallet now lets parents set up secure balances for their kids
items.summary: The tech giant says the new feature will allow parents to teach their kids healthy financial habits while maintaining oversight over their child's spending with built-in safeguards.

items.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
items.summary: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.

items.title: Tesla and SpaceX will invest $16.8B to start building ‘Terafab’ chip factory in Texas
items.summary: After months of speculation, the companies formally announced the massive project will happen just north of Houston.

items.title: OpenAI says Apple’s own security practices undermine its trade secrets case
items.summary: Newly filed court exhibits show OpenAI’s legal strategy in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit: argue that Apple’s own security and offboarding practices — including allowing an Apple manager to access a former engineer’s iCloud account after he left the company —undermine its claims that the allegedly stolen information was properly protected.

items.title: eBay continues to bet on live shopping after record quarter
items.summary: eBay touted an increase in eBay Live's gross merchandise volume as it plans to expand it to more international markets in the coming weeks and months.
